items.docs: Posts a successful Emerge Snapshots GitHub check for a given commit SHA, allowing the PR to merge without running a snapshot comparison. The check will show as completed with a note that it was skipped by the user. This is especially useful in monorepos where the snapshot status check is required but a given PR doesn't include any snapshot-relevant changes.

params.name: headUploadId
params.description: The Emerge ID of the head (current) build to compare

params.name: baseUploadId
params.description: The Emerge ID of the base build to compare against. If not provided and head upload has a base_sha, it will be automatically determined.

params.name: noDiff
params.description: Set to 'true' to skip comparison and return only head build snapshots

params.name: search
params.description: Search query to filter snapshots by name

items.docs: Returns snapshot comparison data between two builds (head and base), including added, removed, changed, and unchanged snapshots. Can also return data for a single build if no base is specified.
Marks a specific snapshot difference as ignored or unignored. When a snapshot difference is ignored, it will not trigger alerts or be counted as a change in snapshot comparisons.
